lines.en: Another weekend morning is another chance to hang out with Touka.
lines.zh: 又一个周末的早晨,又是一次和 Touka 厮混的机会。

lines.en: Or, since Touka doesn’t seem to be around right now, a chance to hang out with her mom and a dejected lesbian.
lines.zh: 或者,既然 Touka 此刻似乎不在,那就成了和她妈妈、以及一个垂头丧气的蕾丝边厮混的机会。

lines.en: Weekends are awesome.
lines.zh: 周末真棒。

lines.en: : Morning. Where’s everyone else?
lines.zh: : 早。其他人呢?

lines.en: : Oh, Sensei. Good day to you. Were you intending to sit in on practice this morning?
lines.zh: : 哦,Sensei。日安。您今早是打算旁听练习吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m sure that’s exactly why he’s here.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我确信他就是为这个来的。

lines.en: : I guess that’s one way to put it. How about you, though? I don’t bump into you over here very often.
lines.zh: : 算是这么回事吧。那你呢?我在这边可不太常碰上你。

lines.en: : Just how frequently are you trespassing in my kyudojo, Arakawa? You know you’re not supposed to be here.
lines.zh: : 你到底有多常擅闯我的弓道场,Arakawa?你知道你不该出现在这里。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, I just missed you so much.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我只是太想你了。

lines.en: : And I miss sleep, but you don’t see me spending day after day in bed.
lines.zh: : 我也想睡觉,可你没见我天天赖在床上。

lines.en: : You know, I really wish I did. You need it.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,我真希望我天天赖床。你需要睡眠。

lines.en: : I was just dropping by to check in on my daughter. But I know she doesn’t like it when I watch her participate in sports, so I wasn’t planning on staying very long.
lines.zh: : 我只是顺路过来看看我女儿。但我知道她不喜欢我观看她运动,所以没打算久留。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, Tsubasa picked the worst day to do this on account of the girls spending today’s morning practice tending to and maintaining their equipment.
lines.zh: : 不巧的是,Tsubasa 挑了个最糟的日子来——因为女孩们今天的晨练内容是保养和维护器材。

lines.en: : Tsubasa? Since when are you two on a first-name basis? I didn’t even realize you knew each other.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa?你们俩什么时候开始直呼其名了?我都不知道你们认识。

lines.en: : We didn’t until just moments ago. And I’m the one who proposed we address each other by our first names as I see no reason to be so formal with a fellow alumna of Higashigaoka Girls’ Academy.
lines.zh: : 方才之前还不认识。提议互相直呼其名的还是我——既然同为 Higashigaoka 女子学园的毕业生,我没理由这般拘礼。

lines.en: : Fellow alumna? But didn’t you go to some super-rich girl school for, like...you know, really rich people? With good manners and all of that stuff?
lines.zh: : 毕业生?可你不是上了某个超级富家女的学校吗,就是……你知道,给真正有钱人上的?讲究礼仪的那种?

lines.en: : I did attend such an academy, yes.
lines.zh: : 我确实上过那样的学园,是的。

lines.en: : And...you’re saying Wakana did too?
lines.zh: : 而……你是说 Wakana 也是?

lines.en: : Unless I’ve been deceived, that is what I am saying. Yes.
lines.zh: : 除非我被骗了,我说的就是这个意思。是的。

lines.en: : You’re a private school girl?
lines.zh: : 你是私立学校出身?

lines.en: : Why do you sound so surprised?
lines.zh: : 你怎么一副吃惊的样子?

lines.en: : You know, if anything, I think this actually helps me understand you even better.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,要说的话,我觉得这反倒帮我更理解你了。

lines.en: : Meanwhile, I’d be shocked to discover you had any sort of formal education whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 与此同时,要是发现你受过任何正规教育,我会震惊的。

lines.en: : You two didn’t go to school together, did you?
lines.zh: : 你们俩没有一起上过学吧?

lines.en: : Oh, heavens no. I’m much, much older than Wakana. She hasn’t even finished her twenties yet.
lines.zh: : 哦,天哪,没有。我比 Wakana 大得多、得多。她连二十多岁都还没过完。

lines.en: : Oh, right. She’s so lifeless that I forget she’s younger than me sometimes.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。她太没有生气了,有时候我都忘了她比我小。

lines.en: : This guy...
lines.zh: : 这家伙……

lines.en: : How old are you, Tsubasa? I don’t think I’ve asked.
lines.zh: : 你多大了,Tsubasa?我好像没问过。

lines.en: : And for good reason. It’s incredibly impolite to ask a woman her age.
lines.zh: : 而且理由充分。问一位女性的年龄,是极其失礼的。

lines.en: : It’s also incredibly impolite to add several years to it.
lines.zh: : 往她的年龄上多加好几岁,同样极其失礼。

lines.en: : If you don’t mind, Sensei, I’d prefer to keep that information confidential. You don’t see me asking you for your age, do you?
lines.zh: : 若你不介意,Sensei,我宁愿对此保密。你没见我打听过你的年龄,对吧?

lines.en: : Don’t need to. I’m 31. Now you know and I get to find out how old you are as well. It's only fair.
lines.zh: : 不用打听。我 31。现在你知道了,也该轮到我得知你的年龄。这才公平。

lines.en: : Oh my. No wonder you’re still so full of life. You’re so young. And with Wakana only several years your junior, the two of you would make excellent-
lines.zh: : 哎呀。难怪你依然如此生气勃勃。你真年轻。而 Wakana 只比你小几岁,你们俩简直是绝妙的——

lines.en: : Enemies.
lines.zh: : 宿敌。

lines.en: : ...Enemies, indeed.
lines.zh: : ……宿敌,确实。

lines.en: : We’re the good kind of enemies, though. The ones who secretly really care about one another deep down.
lines.zh: : 不过我们是好那种宿敌。就是在内心深处暗暗真心在乎彼此的那种。

lines.en: : The only thing I care about is regaining control of the archery range. Get out of here, Arakawa. Go crawl back into your hole.
lines.zh: : 我唯一在乎的是夺回弓道场的控制权。滚出去,Arakawa。爬回你的洞里去。

lines.en: : What she really means to say is, “I can’t wait until I see you again.” To which I would agree.
lines.zh: : 她真正想说的是:「等不及再见你了。」对此我表示同意。

lines.en: : No, what I really mean to say is “Go crawl back into your hole.” Which is exactly what I said because, unlike you, I can get by without sucking the life force out of everyone around me.
lines.zh: : 不,我真正想说的是「爬回你的洞里去」。我就是这么说的,因为和你不一样,我不用吸干周围每个人的生命力也能活下去。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Because apart from you being out in the sun right now, being a vampire would kind of explain a lot.
lines.zh: : 你确定吗?因为除了你此刻站在太阳底下这一点,吸血鬼的说法倒是能解释很多事。

lines.en: : I want you to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我希望你他妈的去死。

lines.en: : Now, now — I understand there’s a bit of hostility between you two, but if you truly do care for one another as you say, you’ll refrain from turning this archery range into a crime scene.
lines.zh: : 好了好了——我明白你们俩之间有点敌意,但要是你们真如所说那样在乎彼此,就请克制,别把这片弓道场变成案发现场。

lines.en: : Sensei, seeing as I’ll be unable to watch my daughter’s practice today, would you care to spend the afternoon with me instead? A nice walk around the grounds seems refreshing, yes?
lines.zh: : Sensei,既然今天看不成我女儿的练习了,不如把下午交给我?在场地周围散个步,想必神清气爽,对吧?

lines.en: : Are you sure you want to spend your time with him? Would you not be better off snapping a twig off of a bush and conversing with that instead?
lines.zh: : 你确定要把时间花在他身上?折一根树丛里的细枝、和它交谈,岂不更好?

lines.en: : Of course not. I wouldn’t want to dirty my gloves.
lines.zh: : 当然不。我可不想弄脏我的手套。

lines.en: : You know what? I’ll take it. A victory over a twig might not sound like much to most people, but for me it’s a pretty big deal.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗?我收下这个胜利。胜过一根细枝,在多数人听来不算什么,但对我来说是件大事。

lines.en: : Would you be so obliged as to join us, Wakana? It isn’t very often I bump into alumnae and I’d greatly enjoy the company of someone with a similar background. No offense to Sensei, of course.
lines.zh: : 愿意赏光同行吗,Wakana?遇见同校毕业生可不常有,与背景相似的人作伴,我会非常愉快。当然,对 Sensei 绝无冒犯之意。

lines.en: : None taken. I wouldn’t have fit in somewhere like that anyway.
lines.zh: : 没觉得被冒犯。反正我也融不进那种地方。

lines.en: : You weren’t even the right sex to be admitted, Arakawa. And no, I’ll respectfully decline your invitation and leave you with your twig. I should be checking on my students anyway.
lines.zh: : 你连入学的性别条件都不符,Arakawa。还有,不,我礼貌地拒绝你的邀请,把细枝留给你。反正我也该去查看我的学生了。

lines.en: : Perhaps the next time I drop by, then. It was nice speaking with you, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 那就下次我再来时吧。和你聊天很愉快,Wakana。

lines.en: : It was nice speaking with you as well.
lines.zh: : 和你聊天也很愉快。

lines.en: : Not you, though.
lines.zh: : 但不包括你。

lines.en: : We’re friends, I swear.
lines.zh: : 我们是朋友,我发誓。

lines.en: : Close ones, at that. The way she told you to “crawl back into your hole” was absolutely dripping with positive sentiment.
lines.zh: : 还是关系很近的那种。她让你「爬回洞里去」的语气,满满都是积极的情谊。

lines.en: : Now then, shall we go? I, regretfully, don’t have much time to spare today. And I’d like to make the most of what I do have that I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 那么,走吧?遗憾的是,我今天没有多少空闲。而我想把现有的时间尽量利用到极致。

lines.en: : Does a stroll around the range fit your schedule, Arakawa-Sensei?
lines.zh: : 在场地周围散步,符合您的日程吗,Arakawa 老师?

lines.en: : Oh, have I graduated from just “Sensei?” I get to have a two-part name now?
lines.zh: : 哦,我已经从单纯的「Sensei」毕业了?我现在有双段名字了?

lines.en: : That didn’t come across as disrespectful, did it?
lines.zh: : 这样称呼没有显得不敬吧?

lines.en: : Not at all. But I was also just called a twig moments ago and didn’t mind, so titles clearly don’t mean much to me.
lines.zh: : 完全没有。不过几分钟前我才刚被叫作「细枝」也没介意,所以头衔对我显然没什么意义。

lines.en: : In that case, I suppose I’ll start using your last name more often. We are business partners now, after all.
lines.zh: : 那样的话,我想我会更常用你的姓氏。毕竟我们现在,是生意伙伴了。

lines.en: : We...are?
lines.zh: : 我们……是吗?

lines.en: : Walk with me. There’s something we need to discuss.
lines.zh: : 陪我走走。有件事需要谈谈。

lines.en: : Oh god, what is it now?
lines.zh: : 天,又是什么事?

lines.en: : After discussing the Chosokabe matter with my daughter, it appears we’re ready to move forward.
lines.zh: : 和我女儿讨论过 Chosokabe 一事以后,看来我们准备好向前推进了。

lines.en: : Okay...and “moving forward” means?
lines.zh: : 好……「向前推进」是指?

lines.en: : Waiting for you to trigger the magnetic reaction that will pull Chika closer to safety, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是等待你去触发那个磁力反应,把 Chika 拉向更安全的地方。

lines.en: : Touka has agreed to listing several of the additional rooms in your complex at a rate well beneath what they’re actually worth.
lines.zh: : Touka 已同意,把你那栋楼里的几间空置房间挂牌出租,租金远低于实际价值。

lines.en: : After all, the goal in investing in the property was never to generate income, but moreso to give her an understanding of how the system and property management work as a whole.
lines.zh: : 毕竟,投资那处房产的目标从来不是创收,而更多是让她理解「体系」和物业管理整体的运作方式。

lines.en: : Is...generating revenue not a part of the “system and property management?”
lines.zh: : 创收……难道不是「体系和物业管理」的一部分吗?

lines.en: : It is. Of course it is. But this is closer to a small project for her than something she’s meant to live off of. Everything she needs and wants is already supplied by the Tsukioka Foundation.
lines.zh: : 是。当然是。但这对她来说更像一个小项目,而非赖以为生的营生。她所需所想的一切,已由 Tsukioka 财团供给。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t it make more sense to...let Chika keep her old apartment and just toss her the key to a new one in the event she changes her mind and wants to move?
lines.zh: : 让 Chika 留着她的旧公寓、只是在哪天她改变主意想搬家时丢给她一把新钥匙,不是更合理吗?

lines.en: : That’s essentially what we’re doing, Arakawa-Sensei. Just instead of tossing her the key, we’re leaving it on the ground for her to pick up.
lines.zh: : 我们本质上就是在做这件事,Arakawa 老师。只是我们不是把钥匙丢给她,而是把它放在地上,让她自己捡。

lines.en: : Unless you don’t want her closer to you for some reason. And that’s certainly not the case, is it?
lines.zh: : 除非出于某种原因,你不想让她离你更近。而这显然不是实情,对吧?

lines.en: : I mean...it could definitely cause some problems.
lines.zh: : 就是说……那确实可能带来一些问题。

lines.en: : Ohh?
: You weren’t intending to use my daughter’s generous gift as a secret love nest, were you? Does having your girlfriend in the same building throw a wrench into things?
lines.zh: : 你该不是打算拿我女儿慷慨的馈赠当秘密爱巢吧?女朋友住在同一栋楼里,会不会坏了你的好事?

lines.en: : It’s a little more complicated than that. I’ve barely even spent any time in that apartment...
lines.zh: : 事情比那稍微复杂一点。我几乎没在那间公寓里待过多久……

lines.en: : But it feels weird to just uproot someone’s life under the guise of “this is better for them” when that shouldn’t be our choice to make.
lines.zh: : 可是以「这是为他们好」为名,连根拔起别人的人生,感觉怪怪的——那本不该是我们替她做的选择。

lines.en: : A well-thought out answer and impressive deflection away from my “love nest” accusation. Though, I wouldn’t say it’s one I agree with.
lines.zh: : 一个深思熟虑的答案,和我「爱巢」指控的一次漂亮闪避。不过,我可不会说我认同它。

lines.en: : And why’s that?
lines.zh: : 为什么呢?

lines.en: : Isn’t it obvious?
lines.zh: : 这还不明显吗?

lines.en: : Most people aren’t smart enough to make their own decisions.
lines.zh: : 大多数人不够聪明,做不出属于自己的决定。

lines.en: : The world would crash and burn if it weren’t for those of us who can bend it to our will...and shape it back into its proper form.
lines.zh: : 若不是我们这些能把它掰弯成自己意志……再把它塑回应有形态的人,这个世界早就撞得粉碎、烧成灰烬了。

lines.en: : Chika’s an amazing girl and I care for her and empathize with her — but she isn’t smart.
lines.zh: : Chika 是个了不起的女孩,我关心她、与她共情——但她不聪明。

lines.en: : She is though. You don’t know her like I do.
lines.zh: : 她明明聪明。你不如我了解她。

lines.en: : I know that she has a sexual relationship with an adult male. And that she’s turning down free aid that would make both her and her sister’s lives easier.
lines.zh: : 我知道她和一个成年男性保持着性关系。也知道她在拒绝一项本可以让她和她妹妹的日子都更好过的无偿援助。

lines.en: : The first of which can be justified under the pretense of you providing some sort of benefit — emotional, physical or financial — but the second?
lines.zh: : 前者还可以用「你能提供某种好处——情感上的、身体上的或金钱上的」来开脱。但后者呢?

lines.en: : The second is pure negligence and stubbornness and will only force her down the same road her mother had to walk before her.
lines.zh: : 后者纯属玩忽与固执,只会把她逼上她母亲当年走过的同一条路。

lines.en: : If I need to reshape things one more time to prevent her from enduring such tragedy, so be it. I do it out of the kindness of my heart and ask for nothing in return.
lines.zh: : 如果需要我再重塑一次现实,好让她免于承受那种悲剧,那就重塑。我出于善心而行,不求回报。

lines.en: : But doing things your way just seems like it’s providing an illusion of free will. It’s not giving Chika or...anyone else you deem “not smart enough” the chance to burn out or fail on their own.
lines.zh: : 可照你的方式行事,看上去只是在提供一种自由意志的幻觉。这没有给 Chika、或者……任何被你判定为「不够聪明」的人,一个亲自燃尽或失败的机会。

lines.en: : Sometimes, people need that if they’re going to improve.
lines.zh: : 有时候,人需要那个,才能真正变好。

lines.en: : I agree. But this isn’t a score on a test or a poorly-made resume- it is a life. Two lives, even.
lines.zh: : 我同意。但这不是一次考试分数,也不是一份糟糕的简历——这是人生。甚至是两条人生。

lines.en: : What’s wrong with playing God when the one we dreamt up never wants to come outside?
lines.zh: : 当我们梦见的那位神明从不愿露面时,扮演神明又有什么错?

lines.en: : As long as nothing crashes and burns, we’ll have succeeded. So you can keep playing the “good cop” all you want while believing the girls you know so well are capable of making their own decisions-
lines.zh: : 只要没有东西撞得粉碎烧成灰烬,我们就算成功了。所以你尽管继续扮演你的「白脸」,一边坚信你如此了解的女孩们有能力自己做决定——

lines.en: : Or you can leave it to the “bad cop” who just-so-happens to have good intentions.
lines.zh: : 或者,把事情交给那位「碰巧」心怀善意的「黑脸」。

lines.en: : You really are “manipulative in the good way,” aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真是「以好的方式富有操纵性」,对吧?

lines.en: : I really am.
lines.zh: : 我确实是。

lines.en: : I respect your speech and all. It’s nice hearing from someone with a mindset like that. But it’s making me a little confused about your stance on Touka.
lines.zh: : 你的高论我全都尊重。听一个有那种思维方式的人讲话,是种享受。但这让我对你对 Touka 的立场,有点困惑。

lines.en: : How so?
lines.zh: : 怎么说?

lines.en: : Do you not think her life is at stake by throwing her into my class at such an impressionable part of her life?
lines.zh: : 你不觉得,在她人生如此易受影响的阶段把她扔进我的课堂,是拿她的人生冒险吗?

lines.en: : She might have a healthy, albeit extremely obnoxious, little sister...but this is her education we’re talking about and you’ve figured out by now that’s, like...the last thing on my list of priorities.
lines.zh: : 她也许有个健康的、尽管极度讨人厌的妹妹……但我们在谈的是她的教育,而你到现在应该已经发现,那是我优先级清单上,那个……排最后的东西。

lines.en: : I guess what I’m asking is...why is she allowed to make her own decisions, but Chika can’t? Is it really just the sister thing that changes all of this?
lines.zh: : 我猜我想问的是……为什么她被允许自己做决定,而 Chika 不行?真的只是「妹妹」这个身份改变了这一切吗?

lines.en: : Not at all. In fact, my repeated presence at this school should be the only hint you need in regard to her autonomy.
lines.zh: : 完全不是。实际上,我在这所学校的反复现身,就该是你判断她自主权所需的唯一提示。

lines.en: : There are several mistakes I want her to make- and she is well on her way to making them.
lines.zh: : 有好几个错误,我希望她去犯——而她正在好好地把它们犯出来。

lines.en: : But it all circles back around to what I want for her as I would never put her into a position where that outcome would be unachievable.
lines.zh: : 但这一切终会绕回我想为她谋取的东西——我绝不会把她置于那个结果无法实现的境地。

lines.en: : You really are just a well-endowed puppeteer, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真就是个天赋异禀的提线人,对吧?

lines.en: : Perhaps I am!
lines.zh: : 也许我是!

lines.en: : Does that make you my puppet?
lines.zh: : 那你就是我的傀儡了?

lines.en: : I guess that depends on whether or not you think I’m “smart enough” to make my own decisions.
lines.zh: : 我猜那取决于,你是否认为我「足够聪明」,能自己做决定。

lines.en: : Surely you’re not making me out to be some sort of villain, are you, Arakawa-Sensei?
lines.zh: : 您该不会是在把我描绘成某种恶人吧,Arakawa 老师?

lines.en: : I’m sure a man of your position can understand my point of view, no?
lines.zh: : 我想,以您地位之尊,应该能理解我的观点,不是吗?

lines.en: : I possess both the intellect and influence to make anything I want a reality. Why would I not do that?
lines.zh: : 我同时拥有把任何所想变成现实的智识与影响力。我为什么不那么做?

lines.en: : Again, you’ve got a point. I’d probably do the same thing in your position.
lines.zh: : 再说一次,你说的有道理。换成你的位置,我大概也会那么做。

lines.en: : Which is why I like you. But that’s enough about me and my points of view — why don’t you tell me a little about yourself?
lines.zh: : 这正是我喜欢你的原因。不过,关于我和我的观点就聊到这里——你何不给我讲讲你自己?

lines.en: : What do you believe in?
lines.zh: : 你相信什么?

lines.en: : What’s your favorite food?
lines.zh: : 你最喜欢的食物是什么?

lines.en: : What kind of music do you like?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢什么样的音乐?

lines.en: : I have so many questions for you.
lines.zh: : 我有好多问题想问你。

lines.en: : This might come as a surprise given my outstanding charisma and boisterous attitude, but I don’t really like talking about myself.
lines.zh: : 以我出众的魅力和咋咋呼呼的态度来说,这也许出乎意料——但我其实不太喜欢谈论自己。

lines.en: : But you’ve learned so much about me so far. And you’ve been addressing me as “Tsubasa” this whole time. Do you not want to be my friend after all?
lines.zh: : 可至今为止,你已经了解了我这么多。而且你这一直以「Tsubasa」相称。你到底还是不想做我的朋友吗?

lines.en: : That’s not it. I’m just not that exciting. That’s really all it is.
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思。我只是没那么有趣。真的仅此而已。

lines.en: : Ohh?
: Perhaps I’ll look into you on my own, then? I can’t have my daughters, biological or not, spending so much time around a man with a shady background, can I?
lines.zh: : 那也许,我会自己去查查你?我可不能让我的女儿们——无论亲生与否——在来历不明的男人身边耗这么多时间,对吧?

lines.en: : You’re not trying to intimidate me right now, are you? Because the smirk and the fact that I have to look up at you were more than enough to do that without the vague threat.
lines.zh: : 你现在该不是在吓唬我吧?因为光凭那个坏笑,和我必须仰头看你的事实,就已经绰绰有余,不需要那个模糊的威胁。

lines.en: : That’s not what I want.
lines.zh: : 那不是我想要的。

lines.en: : I’ve spent so much time looking down on others that being up here is just more comfortable for me. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我俯视别人太久了,站在高处,对我来说只是更舒服而已。仅此而已。

lines.en: : You’re an interesting person, Arakawa-Sensei. And I really do want to learn more about you as I assume you’ll be growing quite familiar with my family in the years to come.
lines.zh: : 你是个有意思的人,Arakawa 老师。我是真心想更了解你——毕竟我猜,在未来的岁月里,你会和我的家人变得相当熟稔。

lines.en: : That “quite familiar” emphasis was a little suggestive, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 那句「相当熟稔」的重音,是不是稍微有点暗示了?

lines.en: : You’ll have to forgive me if my...sincerest thoughts managed to leak out. I just meant that I don’t intend to let you walk away from us is all.
lines.zh: : 如果我……最真诚的念头不小心泄露了出来,还请见谅。我只是想说,我不打算让你从我们身边走开,仅此而已。

lines.en: : We’ve all taken quite the interest in you.
lines.zh: : 我们所有人都对你产生了相当的兴趣。

lines.en: : But, with you unwilling to tell me any more about yourself, it appears that I’ll have to look further into you on my own after all.
lines.zh: : 不过,既然你不愿再多讲讲你自己,看来我终究得亲自去深挖你了。

lines.en: : Come now. You can escort me to the car.
lines.zh: : 来吧。你可以送我上车。

lines.en: Tsubasa gestures as if she’s pulling on puppet strings, but I follow her up the stairs out of my own free will.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 做了个提线的假动作,但我出于自己的自由意志,跟着她走上台阶。

lines.en: Or...what I think is my own free will but is actually just her masterminding my every move like she was alluding to earlier.
lines.zh: 或者说……是我以为的自由意志,实则不过是她——正如她方才暗示的那样——在幕后策划着我的一举一动。

lines.en: She reminds me of someone else in a way.
lines.zh: 在某种意义上,她让我想起另一个人。

lines.en: But the two of them are completely different.
lines.zh: 但她们俩完全不同。

lines.en: I can understand what Tsubasa wants...and it really does seem like she just wants this world to be a better place.
lines.zh: 我能理解 Tsubasa 想要什么……而且看起来,她真的只是想让这个世界变成更好的地方。

lines.en: But “better” is subjective...and she likely hasn’t failed enough in life to know that what “she” wants isn’t what’s best for everyone.
lines.zh: 可「更好」是主观的……而她人生中的失败,多半还不够多,不足以让她明白:「她」想要的,并不就是对所有人最好的。

lines.en: Is she like me — so self-centered that she’ll never be able to look past that?
lines.zh: 她像不像我——自我中心到永远无法越过那道坎?

lines.en: Can she keep believing what she’s done is right even when it’s wrong in every other sense of the word?
lines.zh: 她能否一直相信自己所做的是对的——哪怕在其他所有意义上都错了?

lines.en: Or is she someone who can change the way she thinks...and reshape herself along with the world she treats as a globe, spinning infinitely beneath her finger?
lines.zh: 还是说,她是那种能改变自己思维方式的人……能连同她当作地球仪、在她指尖下无限旋转的这个世界一起,重塑自己?

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I’m not close enough to her yet.
lines.zh: 我和她还不够亲近。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 但是……

lines.en: I don’t mind having her yank my strings a little longer if it changes that.
lines.zh: 如果那能改变这一点,我不介意让她把我的提线再多拽一阵。

lines.en: Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsubasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsubasa_love]!
